goal: Create a small playable monochrome Thumby dodge game that validates the personal game AI workflow from design through fixed tests and implementation.
requirements: Keep game rules independent from the thumby module so they can be tested with CPython.
Move the player left and right within the 72x40 display bounds.
Move an obstacle toward the player and detect collision.
Increase the score when the player successfully avoids an obstacle.
After a collision, enter a game-over state and allow restart by pressing the left and right buttons together.
Use only the verified monochrome Thumby APIs allowed by the thumby generation profile.
Do not start an infinite game loop when a module is imported.
